experimental.notes: Room-T fcc lattice constants; reference choice when matching crystallographic geometry or running LDA/HSE.

pbe.citation: Haas, Tran, Blaha 2009 PRB 79 085104 (Table II) + erratum PRB 79 209902; cross-checked Csonka 2009 PRB 79 155107, Janthon 2013/2014 JCTC 9 1631 / 10 3832
pbe.notes: PBE-XC consistent. Use when running PBE DFT to avoid ~1-2% lead/device lattice mismatch in transport calcs. Ni value assumes SpinPolarized=T (ferromagnetic ground state).

pbe_siesta_psml.citation: user-measured via a bulk-cell relax in their specific SIESTA + PSML setup
pbe_siesta_psml.notes: All-electron PBE (a_pbe) and the value SIESTA+PSML produces can differ by 0.5-1.5% due to pseudopotential + basis effects. Run a bulk-cell relax with the same Au.psml, basis (e.g. DZP), and MeshCutoff to populate this; the workflow is the most accurate option for the user's stack.
